stops.title: p-n junction rectifier & filter circuits
stops.inShort: Half-wave rectifier uses 1 diode (ripple freq = f_in); full-wave / bridge rectifier uses 2 or 4 diodes (ripple freq = 2 f_in). Capacitor filter smooths pulsating DC.
sections: 16.2 p-n Junction Diode as a Rectifier

stops.title: Special purpose diodes (Zener, Photodiode, Solar cell, LED)
stops.inShort: Zener diode operates in reverse breakdown as a voltage regulator. Photodiode (reverse biased) detects light. Solar cell generates emf from light. LED (forward biased) emits light via recombination.

stops.title: Bipolar Junction Transistor (BJT) & amplifier
stops.inShort: Emitter current I_E = I_B + I_C. Current gains: α_dc = I_C/I_E (< 1), β_dc = I_C/I_B (>> 1), relation β = α/(1 − α). CE amplifier provides 180° phase reversal and high voltage/power gain.

stops.title: Logic gates (NOT, OR, AND, NAND, NOR, X-OR)
stops.inShort: AND: Y = A·B (high only when both inputs are high). OR: Y = A+B. NOT: Y = Ā. NAND and NOR are universal gates. X-OR: Y = A⊕B.

items.f: AND: Y=A·B,  OR: Y=A+B,  NAND: Y=!(A·B),  NOR: Y=!(A+B)
items.s: NAND and NOR are universal gates.

board.text: The gate which produces high output, when its both inputs are high is ____.
board.answer: (b) AND gate (Y = A · B = 1 only when A = 1 and B = 1).

board.text: State any four advantages of light emitting diode (LED).
board.answer:
1. Energy efficient (consumes very low power).
2. Long operational lifetime.
3. Fast switching (instantaneous on/off).
4. Compact size, ruggedness, and available in many colours.

points.text: Any two advantages (low power, long life)
Any two more advantages (fast switching, compact/rugged)

board.text: Draw a neat and labelled circuit diagram for a full wave rectifier.
board.answer: Circuit consists of: (1) Step-down centre-tapped transformer (primary connected to AC mains, secondary with centre tap CT), (2) Two p-n junction diodes D₁ and D₂ connected to the two ends of secondary, (3) Load resistor R_L connected between common cathode junction and centre tap CT.
